ResourceUsage.descriptionEn: Query interval, aggregation granularity, and resource usage for each group.
ResourceUsage.description_en: The resource usage for the query interval, aggregation granularity, and each group
ResourceUsage.description_zh: 查询区间、汇总粒度及各组的资源用量

endTime.descriptionEn: Exclusive end of the requested interval.
endTime.description_en: The end time of the requested interval, exclusive
endTime.description_zh: 请求区间的终点，不包含该时刻
endTime.title: 结束时间

granularity.descriptionEn: Aggregation granularity used for this query: All, Hour, or Day.
granularity.description_en: The aggregation granularity used for this query. Valid values: All, Hour, and Day
granularity.description_zh: 本次查询使用的汇总粒度，取值为 All、Hour 或 Day
granularity.title: 用量汇总粒度

groupBy.descriptionEn: Grouping keys used for this query. Empty for an ungrouped query.
groupBy.description_en: The grouping key used for this query. An empty array is returned when no grouping is applied
groupBy.description_zh: 本次查询使用的分组键。不分组时为空数组

items.descriptionEn: A grouping dimension in the result, such as teamID.
items.description_en: The name of the grouping dimension in the result, such as teamID
items.description_zh: 结果中的分组维度名称，例如 teamID
items.title: 分组维度

groupBy.title: 分组键

groups.descriptionEn: Usage by group, or for the entire query scope if no grouping is requested. Returns an empty array if the scope has no usage records.
groups.description_en: The usage for each group. If no grouping is applied, the usage for the entire query range is returned. An empty array is returned if there are no usage records within the query range
groups.description_zh: 各分组的用量。不分组时，返回整个查询范围的用量。查询范围内没有用量记录时返回空数组

additionalProperties.descriptionEn: Value of the named dimension. For example, teamID maps to a team ID.
additionalProperties.description_en: The value of the corresponding dimension, such as the team ID for teamID
additionalProperties.description_zh: 对应维度的取值，例如 teamID 对应团队 ID
additionalProperties.title: 维度值

dimensions.descriptionEn: Team, template, or sandbox plan for this usage group.
dimensions.description_en: The team, template, or sandbox version corresponding to the usage of this group
dimensions.description_zh: 本组用量对应的团队、模板或沙箱版本
dimensions.title: 维度取值

items.descriptionEn: Results for the requested usage items in this group.
items.description_en: The query result for each requested usage item in this group
items.description_zh: 每个请求用量项在本组中的查询结果

buckets.descriptionEn: Hourly or daily usage in chronological order, for intervals with usage records. Omitted when granularity is All.
buckets.description_en: The hourly or daily usage arranged in chronological order. Only time periods with records are returned. This field is omitted when granularity is set to All
buckets.description_zh: 按时间先后排列的小时或日用量，只返回有记录的时段。granularity 为 All 时省略

endTime.descriptionEn: Exclusive end time of this usage interval.
endTime.description_en: The end time of this usage statistics period, exclusive
endTime.description_zh: 这段用量统计的结束时间，区间不含此时刻
endTime.title: 结束时间

quantity.descriptionEn: Total usage over this interval, in the unit specified for this item.
quantity.description_en: The cumulative usage within this time period. The unit is specified by unit
quantity.description_zh: 这段时间内的累计用量，单位见 unit
quantity.title: 分时累计用量

startTime.descriptionEn: Inclusive start time of this usage interval.
startTime.description_en: The start time of this usage statistics period, inclusive
startTime.description_zh: 这段用量统计的开始时间，包含此时刻
startTime.title: 开始时间

buckets.title: 分时用量

total.descriptionEn: Total usage for this item over the query interval. Omitted when the item has no usage records in the interval.
total.description_en: The cumulative usage of this usage item over the entire query interval. This field is omitted if there are no usage records for the item within the interval
total.description_zh: 该用量项在整个查询区间的累计用量。该项在区间内没有用量记录时省略
total.title: 区间累计用量

unit.descriptionEn: Usage unit: CoreSecond (core-seconds) for CPU and GiBSecond (GiB-seconds) for memory and disk.
unit.description_en: The unit of usage. The unit is CoreSecond for CPU, and GiBSecond for memory and cloud disks
unit.description_zh: 用量单位。CPU 为 CoreSecond（核秒），内存和磁盘为 GiBSecond（GiB 秒）
unit.title: 单位

usageName.descriptionEn: Usage item name from the request.
usageName.description_en: The name of the usage item specified in the request
usageName.description_zh: 请求中指定的用量项名称
usageName.title: 用量项名称

items.title: 用量项结果

groups.title: 用量分组列表

startTime.descriptionEn: Inclusive start of the requested interval.
startTime.description_en: The start time of the requested interval, inclusive
startTime.description_zh: 请求区间的起点，包含该时刻
startTime.title: 开始时间

ResourceUsage.title: 资源用量查询结果

parameters.help_en: The ID of the team to query. If you do not specify this parameter, the usage of the current account is queried
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的团队 ID。不填时查询当前账号
parameters.name: team_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the template to query. You must also specify the teamID to which the template belongs
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的模板 ID。请同时填写模板所属的 teamID
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The sandbox edition to query. Valid values: eco, std, pro, and ent
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的沙箱版本，可选 eco、std、pro、ent
parameters.name: sandbox_plan

parameters.help_en: The grouping keys. You can group the results by any combination of teamID, templateID, and sandboxPlan. Each key can be specified only once. If you do not specify this parameter, the results are aggregated over the entire query scope
parameters.help_zh: 可按 teamID、templateID、sandboxPlan 的任意组合分组，各键只填一次。不填时按整个查询范围汇总
parameters.name: group_by

parameters.help_en: The usage items to query. You can query 1 to 6 different usage items at a time. CPU usage items include cpuActive and cpuIdle. Memory usage items include memoryActive and memoryIdle. Disk usage items include disk and diskDeepSleep. The disk item includes the usage of disks in deep sleep mode
parameters.help_zh: 一次可查询 1～6 个不同的用量项。CPU 包括 cpuActive、cpuIdle，内存包括 memoryActive、memoryIdle，磁盘包括 disk、diskDeepSleep。disk 包含深度休眠磁盘用量
parameters.name: usage_names

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. This time is inclusive. Specify the time on the hour in UTC, such as 00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间，包含此时刻。请填写 UTC 整点，例如 00:00 UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. This time is exclusive. Specify the time on the hour in UTC. The latest allowed end time is the start of the current hour. You can query data for a maximum of 7 days at a time. The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间，区间不含此时刻。请填写 UTC 整点，最晚可填当前小时的起点。一次可查询最多 7 天，结束时间须晚于开始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The granularity at which usage data is aggregated. Set this parameter to All to view the cumulative usage over the entire query interval, to Hour to view the hourly usage, or to Day to aggregate the usage every 24 hours from the start time. The last interval can be less than 24 hours
parameters.help_zh: 选 All 可查看整个查询区间的累计用量。选 Hour 按小时查看。选 Day 从 startTime 起每 24 小时汇总，最后一段可不足 24 小时
parameters.name: granularity

code.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates success. Other values indicate specific error codes
code.description_zh: 成功时为 200。失败时为对应的错误码

message.description_en: The message that describes the result of the request

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request

resourceUsage.description_en: The usage results for the query interval and each group
resourceUsage.description_zh: 查询区间及各组的用量结果
